title: Italian-Style Frittata with Cabbage
description: A flavorful and nutritious breakfast dish made with cabbage, vibrant eggs, and velvety cheese, all wrapped up in a delicious Italian-inspired frittata.

ingredients.name: eggs
ingredients.notes: Vibrant eggs provide the base of this dish

ingredients.name: cabbage
ingredients.notes: Shredded cabbage adds a sweet crunch

ingredients.name: italian cheese blend
ingredients.notes: Velvety cheese melts beautifully into the eggs

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: Season with salt to bring out the flavors

ingredients.name: garlic powder
ingredients.notes: A hint of garlic powder complements the dish

instructions: Whisk eggs in a large bowl and set aside.
In a large skillet, sauté the shredded cabbage over medium heat until softened.
Add the Italian cheese blend to the skillet and stir until melted.
Pour the whisked eggs over the cabbage mixture and cook until the eggs start to set.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Use a spatula to loosen the frittata from the skillet and slide it onto a plate.
Slice the frittata into wedges and serve hot.
